signals.text: ICYMI: Lauren Betts is running her own race as a rookie with the Washington Mystics, and it's working out for her.

signals.text: As expected, Angela Dugalić and Lauren Betts are starting tonight for the Washington Mystics in the absence of Kiki Iriafen and Shakira Austin.
